result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection in a commercial area with significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle design with minimal protection or refuge for those on foot.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic over a long distance without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The existing transverse crosswalk markings are faded and lack high visibility, making them less noticeable to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.
